description: The workspace's private deals address and how far its setup got. Brand emails sent there (a Gmail filter forwards them, or the creator forwards one by hand) become inquiries checked against the deal rules, so nobody has to read the inbox for deals. Made on first read. Give the creator the address and the two Gmail links; they add the address in Gmail, confirm Gmail's code, then save the filter. recent shows what arrived this week: filed as inquiries, or skipped with the reason (forwarding a skipped email to the address by hand files it). available false: not set up on this server.
